ratings.note: Every run that follows the ingest instruction for unmatched themes meets a schema with no legitimate role for feedback, and the forced disguise as a heuristic evaluator silently inflates the k-of-N detection counts the person relies on; it is major rather than catastrophic because it is confined to the optional feedback path and miscounts agreement rather than inventing findings.

The nested step shape is a natural guess that recurred across three evals and several agent roles, but the error is loud and each fresh agent recovers after a retry, so it costs time and guessing rather than correctness.
